translations: # Chengdu Children's Hospital introduces a new minimally invasive procedure (fictional example)
In March 2025, the surgical team of Chengdu Children's Hospital in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, completed its 100th laparoscopic operation.
Team leader Professor Zhang Minghua said the postoperative complication rate fell from 12.5% to 8.4%, and the average hospital stay was shortened to 3.2 days.
Zhang Ming-hua explained that the technique was first introduced in Beijing in 2019 and has since spread to Chongqing, Xi'an and other cities.
Experts caution that these data come from a single-centre observational series and cannot establish a causal relationship.
